scope: Current evidence corrections are separate from historical authoring status and positive semantic test coverage. These fixture gaps remain unresolved follow-up work.

reviews.scope_limit: This is a corpus evidence correction, not a passing semantic feature test or an unsupported-library claim. The historical authoring inventory stays unchanged; a native specimen of this specific feature is still needed.

reviews.reason: Native legacy visual retention does not prove the build-based diagram/SmartArt semantic inventory is exercised.
reviews.required_evidence: An editable DiagramBuildContainer/DiagramBuildAtom owner with its associated OfficeArt shape references in the legacy slide.
reviews.observed_evidence: The SMARTART_PROCESS_002 slide has placeholder 4097 and picture 4098. Its 47633-byte PNG hashes to a018e672221c348c6b90c9ed6611f42e2a2333f5b668a3425843bdf2cf348ca7. The PPT file has only SlideTime10Atom in PPT10 metadata; its PPS/POT derivatives have no PPT10 records, and diagram projection returns Refused(UnsupportedTarget).
reviews.scope_limit: This proves the saved picture representation and absence of the supported build owner; it does not claim every possible opaque SmartArt compatibility record is absent, or that a picture/empty inventory qualifies diagram semantics. A native build-bearing legacy specimen remains needed.
